packageRules.description: Majors wait 30 days, then sit on the Dependency Dashboard until ticked there; they never open a PR on their own.

Mastra packages are released together and peer on each other's versions; updating them separately can land a mismatched set. @mastra/otel-exporter stays out: it is pinned (1.3.11+ crashed at import) and must not hold the rest of the group back.
The ai core and its @ai-sdk/* providers share internal provider-utils versions, so they move as one.

TypeScript 7: typescript-eslint peers on '>=4.8.4 <6.1.0' and hard-errors with 'typescript-eslint does not support TS 7.0'. tsc itself passes clean on 7.0.2 under Next 16 — only the lint toolchain blocks it. Track typescript-eslint#10940 and drop this rule when it ships TS 7 support.

ESLint 10: eslint-plugin-react 7.37.5 peers on '<=^9.7' and crashes on the removed context.getFilename API. eslint-config-next depends on it, so this unblocks only when that plugin ships ESLint 10 support.
@types/node tracks the Node major the Dockerfile actually runs (24 LTS), not the newest published types.
